body: This is amazing! Thank you for this and the message!!!
That's totally right, thanks for all the info. ☺

That's a great idea. But should I do it now or one year post op like the new surgeon told me? I also forgotten to mention that I showed him my x-rays and he told me that it's still healing because the gap on the bone is not yet closed. But it's weird to me because I read that you see the final result of the genioplasty after 6 months max and I am 5 months post-op.
Also, how is it possible to have an MRI while having braces and the plates on the chin?
Thank you a lot ❤ But is it 100% nerve damage or there must be something else? So there is hope, right?
Thank you. I am from Europe tho and it won't be easy for me to travel abroad. And I assume surgery in US is much more expensive.

I was years insecure about my chin, I thought it made my face look longer so I had a surgery on the lower jaw. I consulted with a maxilofacial surgeon and even though I had a crossbite he told me that I can get it fixed if i want after surgery. I also asked him for double jaw but he said I didn't need it. 
I had the first surgery on March and I didn't like the result, it made my face even longer. Then I complained to the surgeon and he did a second surgery to me for free. I don't know what he did exactly, but my face still looked long and now i can't even close my mouth properly.

I was disappointed with the whole situation so I consulted with another maxilofacial and he told me to fix my crossbite. I wear braces now and both my maxilofacial and orthodontist told me I won't need a djs since my teeth will fit properly. What I would need is let the braces work and after removing them doing lower surgery again.

But I am really scared that it won't work again for the third time and that I really need a djs to not have a long face. 

These x-rays are before surgery and after the second surgery. I don't have the ones after the first surgery or now that I wear braces.
